name: com.pattarapol.smart-tooltip
description: Tutorial tooltips that point at anything: UI, 2D sprites, 3D objects, even things off screen or behind the camera. The screen dims, a hole opens around the target, and rules pick which tip to show.

samples.description: Three buttons on a canvas. Rules pick the next tip from the game state.
Orbiting camera, a runner that leaves the screen, an object turned in depth and one that ends up behind the camera.
